name: WhatsApp channel settings and team user identity
description:
## Context
Project: codx-api (FastAPI) at /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/api.
Goal of this line of work: a full-duplex bridge between a codx-junior messenger chat (`Chat`, incl. group chats) and a WhatsApp group or 1:1 chat, using the OFFICIAL WhatsApp Cloud API (graph.facebook.com). The WhatsApp side acts as a TEAM USER: every outbound message is authored by a `CodxUser` chosen in settings. All channel configuration and secrets must live in settings (env var references), never in the repo or in `.codx` JSON files.

## Objective
Add the settings model that holds the WhatsApp channel configuration and the sender identity.

## Steps
1. In `codx/junior/model/model.py` add `WhatsAppSettings(BaseModel)`:
   - `enabled: bool = False`
   - `api_version: str` (default from env `CODX_JUNIOR_WHATSAPP_API_VERSION`, never hardcode a version in code paths that build URLs)
   - `phone_number_id: str`, `business_account_id: str` (WABA)
   - `access_token: str` (stored as an env var reference, resolved with `os.path.expandvars` like `ai_providers` does)
   - `app_secret: str` (needed for `X-Hub-Signature-256` validation, env var reference)
   - `verify_token: str` (webhook handshake)
   - `webhook_path: str = "/api/channels/whatsapp/webhook"`
   - `default_sender_username: str` — the team `CodxUser` that signs outbound messages
   - `default_project_id: Optional[str]`, `reply_policy: str = "off"` (`off|mention|prefix|always`)
   - `user_mapping: Dict[str, str]` — `wa_id -> username`
2. Embed it in `GlobalSettings` as `whatsapp` (`codx/junior/global_settings.py` / `model/model.py`), and expose it through the existing global settings read/write helpers.
3. Add a `settings.whatsapp` accessor on `CODXJuniorSettings` (`codx/junior/settings.py`) that falls back to `GLOBAL_SETTINGS.whatsapp`, following the `get_llm_settings` / `get_project_workspaces` pattern.
4. Resolve secrets at use time (never persist the resolved value). Missing `access_token`/`phone_number_id` must disable the channel with a clear log line, not raise at import time.

## Files
- codx/junior/model/model.py
- codx/junior/global_settings.py
- codx/junior/settings.py

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `GlobalSettings` round-trips `whatsapp` through `read_global_settings` / `write_global_settings`.
- [ ] A project without the platform settings gets `enabled=False` and no exception.
- [ ] No token or app secret is written to `.codx/*.json` or into git; only env var names.
- [ ] Docstrings state where each value comes from and who can edit it (admin only).
